title: CPU Exhaustion via Crafted TOML Files in translation-finder
vulnerabilityInformation: A CPU exhaustion vulnerability was discovered in a translation file discovery library. The vulnerability existed in functions that checked TOML files to determine if they were in a specific format. These functions read files one character at a time in a loop without implementing line length restrictions. Specially crafted TOML files containing single lines approximately 1 MB in length were found to cause scanning operations to take 7 to 8 seconds instead of milliseconds. A repository containing approximately 64 such malicious files was demonstrated to trigger the full processing delay. The vulnerability was confirmed to affect version 3.7.1 and a specific commit of the affected project.
